answer: Beacon-decay seal: a lotus seal guards each identity; it wilts to zero by the next pulse unless one verified job is filed. A wilted identity strands like an island, cut from rewards until it re-buys a 60-credit seal. Seals live on a dune ledger: re-buyers leave one visible cluster, and rented work fails the key check. 1,000 fakes x 60 credits = 60,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool, a 20,000 loss. Honest growers file one job, renew free.
